clips.title: The story
paras: Across the southern bluffs of the Valley of Trials, Sarkoth's Mangled Claw bears the mark of a wounded hunter. Hana'zua's crushing blow scarred the scorpid's pincer before its venomous sting struck him down.

Hana'zua, a young Darkspear troll, met Sarkoth while hunting in the Valley of Trials. The massive scorpid's venomous stinger pierced his chest, leaving him bleeding beneath a nearby tree. Before the blow landed, Hana'zua crushed the beast's pincer. Its severed, battered claw proves Sarkoth has been slain. For the wounded hunter, that scar on the beast is proof his desperate strike left its mark, and a last hold on his warrior's honor as venom courses through his veins.
